_comment: A3: register osc-alert-hook.sh so a bare Tern-hosted claude/codex seat signals 'needs human' via OSC 9;4 (read by the A2 sentinel's pane.alert and by cx.agents waiting_input). Merge into ~/.claude/settings.json. Copy osc-alert-hook.sh to a stable path (e.g. ~/.agenthop/tern-panes/osc-alert-hook.sh) and chmod +x first. Outside a Tern pane the hook is a no-op, so it is safe on every seat.
